description: Turn the tables in a PDF into Excel, each in its own sheet and with numbers as numbers, ready to add up. Returns a link to download the result (kept about an hour). Credits on paid plans: 5 per page.

content.description: What to put in Excel Values: 'tablas' = Just the tables, one sheet per table; 'todo' = All the text, one sheet per page

files.description: Input files (.pdf). Each one is a public http(s) URL, or an object with `url`, or with `name` and `content_base64` (small files only: up to 20 MB in total).

anyOf.description: public http(s) URL of the file

name.description: file name with its extension, e.g. report.pdf

url.description: public http(s) URL of the file

lang.description: Language. Language of the texts the tool adds. Values: 'es' = Spanish; 'en' = English

name: pdf_to_excel
title: Convert PDF to Excel
